summary: Neo dives from the maze down a service alley, only to find it is a dead end. He turns back as the Agents emerge from the market. Trapped, he calls out for help: "Uh, help! Need a little help!"

what_changes.before: Fleeing down the maze in hope of escape
what_changes.after: Cornered in a dead-end alley with the Agents closing in
what_changes.evidence: He dives from the maze down a service alley but it is a dead end.

what_changes.before: Trying to escape silently on his own
what_changes.after: Forced to call out for help
what_changes.evidence: Neo turns back as the Agents emerge from the market. NEO Uh, help! Need a little help!

event_hint.one_line: Neo runs into a dead-end alley and, with the Agents emerging from the market, calls out for help.
